title: Links and Hyperlinks
description: Links and hyperlinks allow users to navigate from one webpage to another or access external websites and resources.
They are created using the <a> tag along with the href attribute, which specifies the destination address.
Hyperlinks are essential for website navigation because they connect different pages and provide access to additional information, making the web an interconnected network of resources.

example.output: A clickable text labeled 'Visit Google' that opens Google.
